svg.title: Ragged regions — 010 / Before the boundary is named — Reader
svg.desc: Fog of war, Ragged regions: 010 / Before the boundary is named, Reader. Schematic drawn claim terrain; P1 hatched; P2 dark; P3 dark; P4 dark; P5 hatched. P1 outer foothold hatched. Observation islands: response dark, correction hatched, configuration dark, weights dark. P6 is only an unnamed dark hint. Dark means no available support, not false. Contours remain fixed across fixtures. Design sample, not adopted. Fog has a soft irregular edge; unexplored ground is opaque, ground that lost support stays dimly visible. Propositions and observations are pictograms beneath the fog, not text; a key names them outside the map.
svg.text: THE READER HAS A CORRECTION THE PEOPLE INSIDE THE EVENT DO NOT.
010.3–4 / disputed scorer accounts; design / fixed response boundary · OUR INFERENCE / SCHEMATIC TERRAIN / FOG IS COMPUTED, NOT MEASURED
